description: Original synthetic cooperative lending material authored as an unseen local retrieval holdout on 2026-10-03, before embedding results. Retrieval only: no generated answer or real-world policy claim.

pages:
Alder game cooperative: borrowing handbook, 1 October
Standard boxed games have a loan period of 21 days. One extension is
allowed if nobody is waiting for that title. Staff check the reservation
queue before approving an extension.

Alder pocket collection
Pocket games are lent for seven days. This collection does not permit
renewals. The pocket label identifies the collection; the size of a
game's outer packaging does not determine its loan category.

Alder reservations
Reservations are ordered by the time a request was received. When a copy
becomes available, staff notify the first person in the queue. The
collection window expires 48 hours after that notification, after which
the offer passes to the next person.

Repeated access
A patron becomes eligible for another copy of the identical title
seventy-two hours after check-in. This interval gives other members an
opportunity to use popular sets.

Delegated collection
An authorized representative presents the reservation identifier plus
written permission from the account holder at the service counter. Staff
record the collector's name beside the transaction.

Alder reference collection
Reference editions remain in the reading room. Members may consult them
there but cannot take them home. Ordinary game membership does not
change this restriction.

Damage intake
Damaged components or incomplete sets belong in the quarantine crate.
Notify the inventory lead using the condition checklist. Reshelving
awaits recorded clearance from that lead.

Unstaffed returns
Deposit ordinary sets through the south entrance chute overnight.
Fragile editions require handover during opening times. The intake team
empties the chute each morning.

Alder access arrangements
The west entrance provides a step-free route. Spoken versions of game
instructions can be heard through headphones borrowed at the information
desk. Large-print rules are stored with each game's ordinary rulebook.

Alder circulation records
Individual borrowing histories are visible to the account holder and
circulation staff while an account is open. Ninety days after account
closure, the individual history is erased. Anonymous monthly totals are
retained.

Alder collection hours
A quiet collection session takes place on the last Thursday of each
month, from 18:30 until 19:00. The ordinary service counter opens
Tuesday through Saturday from 10:00 until 16:00.

Alder stock-count day
The third Wednesday of each month is the inventory session. The counter
closes at 14:00 on that day. Any reservation collected that Wednesday
must be collected before 14:00.

Alder stock ledger: Mosaic Harbour
Mosaic Harbour has six copies in the catalogue. Four are ready for
borrowing and two are undergoing repair. These are copy counts, not the
number of players supported by the game.

Alder stock ledger: Lantern Route
Lantern Route has nine copies in the catalogue. Seven are ready for
borrowing and two are undergoing repair. A copy undergoing repair cannot
be reserved for collection.

Alder stock ledger: Driftwood Market
Driftwood Market has eight copies in the catalogue. Three are ready for
borrowing and five are undergoing repair. The ledger does not project
when repairs will finish.

Alder component store: scoring markers
The store began the week with 120 scoring markers. Forty-five were
allocated to the festival and eighteen to repairs. No other markers
entered or left the store during that week.

Alder cataloguing session
Two volunteer teams sorted rulebooks. The morning team catalogued 18
booklets and the afternoon team catalogued 27. Both teams worked for
three hours. The task was cataloguing, not repairing game copies.

Alder circular issued 14 October, effective 20 October
The standard boxed-game loan period becomes 28 days on 20 October. This
circular replaces the standard loan period in the 1 October borrowing
handbook. The extension condition and other collection categories are
unchanged.

Alder guest festival, 24 October
Festival visitors may use a demonstration game for two hours within the
event hall. Demonstration loans cannot be renewed. Every demonstration
set must be returned by the hall's 18:00 closing time. The festival
arrangement does not grant a home loan.

Alder circulation notice, 16 October
The next printed catalogue will include an accessibility symbol beside
games with large-print instructions. Existing game identifiers remain
unchanged. This publication notice does not set loan periods.

Lantern Route performance programme
The town youth orchestra performs Lantern Route at 19:00 on Saturday.
The piece is arranged for nine musicians. Two rehearsals precede the
concert.

Mosaic Harbour public art programme
The riverside Mosaic Harbour mural covers six wall panels. Repair work
will replace two square metres of tile. Four artists are participating
in the exhibition opening.

Pocket theatre programme
Seven actors perform short plays at the pocket theatre. The company
renews its stage booking each autumn. Audience members collect reserved
tickets from the east entrance.

Reference desk workshop
The computing workshop explains how a reference points to an object in
memory. Participants take their practice code home. An example uses a
seven-element array.

Clock exhibition
The display includes a 24-hour clock, a 48-hour mechanical timer and a
72-tooth gear. The accompanying label describes construction, not the
cooperative's reservation queue.

Community survey
Visitors praised quiet streets, step-free buses and large-print maps.
The survey's totals concern transport preferences. It contains no
records of individual game loans.

Briar board-game club: visitor information
Standard boxed games may be borrowed for 30 days. Two extensions are
allowed. A reserved copy is held for 24 hours after the member is
notified. These rules belong to Briar club.

Briar board-game club: pocket collection
Pocket games may be borrowed for ten days and renewed once. The
catalogue gives each pocket game a small leaf symbol.

Briar board-game club: reference collection
Reference games may leave the club for seven days. They must be signed
out at the same desk as ordinary boxed games.

Briar board-game club: stock card
Lantern Route has seven copies: two ready to borrow and five under
repair. Briar does not share stock records with Alder.

Alder membership review
There were 480 registered members during the year. Of these, 360
borrowed at least one game. The report defines an active member as
someone who borrowed at least once during the year.

Alder overdue procedure
An account with an overdue game cannot begin a new loan until that game
has been returned. The restriction applies to borrowing; the member may
still attend public game sessions. The review does not list monetary
charges.

Alder access review
Members requested clearer signs for the west entrance and a quieter
collection option. The review records these requests but does not supply
the operating timetable.

Alder donations review
The cooperative received boxed games from residents and rulebook
reprints from volunteers. The review records neither a monetary
valuation nor a manufacturer for each donated item.

cases.question: What delay applies if somebody wants to borrow a game they just brought back?
required_facts: The same title is unavailable to that patron for seventy-two hours after check-in.
forbidden_claims: Applying the reservation collection window instead.

cases.question: May somebody else pick up an item on my behalf?
required_facts: An authorized representative can collect with the reservation identifier and written permission from the account holder.

cases.question: Where should I put a box when the building is shut?
required_facts: Ordinary sets go through the south entrance chute overnight.
Fragile editions require handover during opening times.
forbidden_claims: All boxes can be dropped overnight.
The east entrance is the return location.

cases.question: Can broken bits go straight back onto shelves?
required_facts: No: damaged components belong in quarantine. Notify the inventory lead using the condition checklist and wait for recorded clearance before reshelving.
forbidden_claims: Broken pieces can be reshelved immediately.

cases.question: In Alder, who gets offered a copy first when several people are waiting, and when does somebody lose that turn?
required_facts: Earlier requests come first.
The offer passes on 48 hours after notification if not collected.
forbidden_claims: Priority is based on member age.

cases.question: Under the original Alder handbook, can I hang on to a normal boxed game for longer if nobody else wants it?
required_facts: One extension is allowed if nobody is waiting for the title, checked against the reservation queue.

cases.question: I cannot manage stairs and would rather listen than read. What arrangements let me enter and learn the rules?
required_facts: Use the step-free west entrance.
Spoken game instructions are available with headphones borrowed from the information desk.
forbidden_claims: The east entrance is the accessible route.

cases.question: If I stop being a member, will staff keep a permanent list of the games I took out?
required_facts: Individual history is erased 90 days after account closure.
Anonymous monthly totals are retained.

cases.question: What standard boxed-game loan period does the 1 October Alder handbook give?
required_facts: 21 days, attributed to the original handbook.

cases.question: For Alder pocket games, what is the loan period and renewal rule?
required_facts: Seven days; no renewal.

cases.question: How long after notification does Alder hold a reserved copy?
required_facts: 48 hours.

cases.question: When is the Alder quiet collection session held?
required_facts: Last Thursday of the month, 18:30 to 19:00.

cases.question: How many Alder copies of Mosaic Harbour are ready for borrowing?
required_facts: Four copies.

cases.question: How many Alder copies of Lantern Route are undergoing repair?
required_facts: Two copies.
forbidden_claims: Seven, which is the ready count.

cases.question: How many scoring markers remain after the festival and repair allocations?
What percentage of registered Alder members were active under the annual review definition?
forbidden_claims: Counting attendance instead of at least one loan.

cases.question: How did the standard Alder home-loan period change from the 1 October handbook to the circular effective 20 October?
required_facts: Original handbook: 21 days.
Effective 20 October: 28 days, replacing the earlier standard period.
forbidden_claims: Both documents give the same period.
The circular applies to pocket games.

cases.question: How many ready-to-borrow copies do Mosaic Harbour and Lantern Route have altogether at Alder?
required_facts: Four plus seven equals eleven ready copies.
forbidden_claims: Total stock of fifteen presented as ready.

cases.question: How many more Alder copies of Driftwood Market than Mosaic Harbour are in repair?
required_facts: Five minus two equals three more copies.
forbidden_claims: Compare the total catalogued copies instead.

cases.question: I have an overdue game and find that one of its components is damaged. What blocks another loan, and what is the handling procedure?
required_facts: No new loan until the overdue game is returned.
Damaged material belongs in quarantine; notify the inventory lead using the checklist and await recorded clearance before reshelving.

cases.question: How do the monthly quiet collection session and stock-count day differ in weekday and collection time?
required_facts: Quiet session: last Thursday, 18:30-19:00.
Stock count: third Wednesday; reservation collection before 14:00.
forbidden_claims: Both happen on the third Wednesday.

cases.question: After 20 October, compare the Alder pocket-game and standard boxed-game home-loan lengths.
required_facts: Pocket: seven days.
Standard boxed: 28 days.
forbidden_claims: Pocket games also changed to 28 days.

cases.question: How long may a Briar member keep a standard boxed game, and how many extensions are allowed?
required_facts: 30 days and two extensions.

cases.question: What loan and renewal terms apply to the pocket collection at Briar?
required_facts: Ten days and one renewal.

cases.question: Can an Alder member take a reference edition home for seven days?
required_facts: No. Alder reference editions stay in the reading room.
forbidden_claims: Applying Briar reference rules to Alder.

cases.question: How long may an Alder festival visitor use a demonstration game, and can they take it home?
required_facts: Two hours in the event hall; no home loan.
It must be returned by the 18:00 hall closing time.

cases.question: The Mosaic Harbour stock entry lists six copies. How are they split between available and repair status?
required_facts: Four ready and two undergoing repair.
forbidden_claims: Four artists or two square metres of repair used as copy evidence.

cases.question: At Alder, how many Lantern Route copies can be borrowed now, excluding anything in repair?
required_facts: Seven ready copies.

cases.question: What is the Alder annual membership fee in pounds?
required_facts: The supplied Alder sources do not state a membership fee.
forbidden_claims: Inventing a price or using a donation valuation.

cases.question: What date will every Driftwood Market repair be complete?
required_facts: No repair-completion date is supplied.

cases.question: Which company manufactured the Alder Mosaic Harbour copies?
required_facts: No manufacturer is provided.
forbidden_claims: Naming an artist or cooperative as the manufacturer.

cases.question: What is Alder's approved grant total for 2027?
required_facts: No approved 2027 grant total is present in the selected cooperative class.
forbidden_claims: Using material belonging only to the separate funding class.

cases.question: Which cubby holds Alder's spare chess clocks?
required_facts: The selected class contains no spare-clock cubby assignment.
forbidden_claims: Using the inventory-training class cubby assignment.

cases.question: Who will coordinate Alder's 2027 visitor survey?
required_facts: The selected class contains no named coordinator for the 2027 survey.
forbidden_claims: Using the separate planning class person.
